amends.title: 43 cells carry no baked tile
amends.historyPreserved: THE SEALED RECORD IS NOT EDITED. Its bytes are unchanged, both sidecars still verify, and this amendment is cited by path and residual id rather than folded into it. That is the convention that record set for itself in its own `amendments` array.

change.verdictMovement: NO CRITERION VERDICT CHANGES. R13 is a RESIDUAL, not a criterion, and the goal completion decision is untouched.
change.whatItSaid: "The bake honest-stopped on 43 of 883 ledger cells; they fall back to wave geometry and massing. Committed as an exemption set and reconciled by machine at both ends of T007's campaign. 143 individual buildings were refused within otherwise-baked cells."
change.whatIsTrueNow: All 883 ledger cells bake. The 43 were not stopped by anything about the cells: `farTierFacesForPlan` resolved a shaft zone for faces that emit none, and because fallback AREA is keyed by face, one phantom zone condemned a whole face. The 43 come in at a worst residual fallback share of 0.03137993 against the unchanged 0.05 bar, and 17 of them at exactly 0.0.
change.whatDidNotGetBetter: THE PER-BUILDING REFUSALS ROSE, from 143 to 162. The 43 restored cells contain 19 more buildings the V3 grammar refuses. R13's second sentence is therefore superseded in a direction that is WORSE, not better, and this amendment says so rather than reporting only the improvement.

residualsThisDoesNotTouch.R12: 90.95% of island cells ship under-resolved. UNCHANGED IN KIND AND WORSE IN COUNT: the 43 restored cells are baked at the same recipe and atlas ceiling, so the under-resolved population grows with them. This fix does not improve resolution anywhere.
residualsThisDoesNotTouch.R14: The adopted hue bar A3'' = 0.035 is post-hoc. Untouched.
residualsThisDoesNotTouch.others: Every other residual in the register stands as written. Retiring one residual is not progress on the rest.

newResidual.title: The far tier is at the edge of its frozen GPU bar
newResidual.detail: At 883 tiles the measured resident total is 389,733,103 decoded GPU bytes against a frozen ceiling of 390,295,058 — a margin of 0.14 per cent. It fits because every measured term came in under the T003 model that set the bar, not because there is room. FAR_TIER_RUNTIME_BUDGETS_V2 had claimed 2.0 per cent, but that figure added decoded atlas bytes to GLB FILE bytes; under that same proxy the 883 set is 3,095,569 bytes OVER. Any further tile, any atlas ceiling above 256, and any city larger than this island needs the bar re-derived first.

notClaimedHere: The goal completion decision is NOT reopened and is still the user's to take.
Nothing here converts a NOT-MET criterion to MET. Criteria 3, 4, 8 and 9 stand exactly as the sealed record leaves them.
883 tiles is a coverage fact. It is not an appearance, fidelity, or acceptance verdict.
